incidents.name: BBOX flash-loan price manipulation
incidents.notes: The BBOX token's transfer fee removes tokens from the liquidity pair's own balance without a sync(), so the attacker collapsed the BBOX reserve and swapped out the pair's WBNB.

sources.ref: onchain review: BBOX 0x5DfC7f3EbBB9Cbfe89bc3FB70f750Ee229a59F8c created 2022-03-28T13:23:48Z by 0xf6a6dd4e88df2da99e6f88a84dbeab01c25076b3, unrelated to attack sender 0x32b639c180b130ed6b785d622b5c56ff48bbdf83; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 38.2252 WBNB left the BBOX pair 0x7a2d2ec352ae6d5e4b5d74918d594e2a0a80b348 to the attack contract; 38.2252 WBNB x $274.34 at incidentTimestamp 1668606594 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $10,487.
